macos.rationale: The desktop page offers the OpenCode desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

windows.rationale: The desktop page offers the OpenCode desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

linux.rationale: The desktop page offers the OpenCode desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

ios.rationale: The mobile page links the iPhone app as a public TestFlight beta that anyone can join, which counts as available. It is a remote for OpenCode on the user's computer.

android.rationale: The mobile page links an Android app on Google Play (ai.opencode.mobilecode). It is a remote for OpenCode on the user's computer. The earlier "coming soon" restriction is gone.

mobile-web.rationale: At v2.3.2 the web session client served by the user's OpenCode server switches to a narrow-screen layout below 768px.

cli.rationale: OpenCode ships its own terminal client and CLI commands (opencode, opencode serve, opencode pair).

opencode.rationale: OpenCode provides its own agent runtime with configurable model providers. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

claude-code.rationale: The shipped local Claude Agent plugin launches the installed Claude Code CLI through its official SDK, persists/resumes Claude sessions and manages the process. OpenCode supplies tools/permissions/compaction/subagents; Claude builtin tools/settings and remote workspaces are excluded.

codex.rationale: The supplied registry has OpenCode and native Claude Agent session execution; the other named entries are model-provider API routes. The bounded shipped registry has no supplied session adapter for this harness.

byo-subscription.rationale: ChatGPT Plus or Pro sign-in. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode iPhone TestFlight remote, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

local.rationale: Sessions run in the OpenCode service on the user's computer; mobile apps only steer them.

own-server.rationale: opencode serve runs a standalone server on a shared, always-on or remote host the user operates, under systemd, Docker or another supervisor.

worktree.rationale: Git worktrees are a documented workspace option (desktop selection; worktree.directory configures where new local worktrees go). A worktree separates files and is not a sandbox.

parallel-runs.rationale: Concurrent sessions. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

coordinator.rationale: OpenCode supplies its own parent agent with a child-session delegation tool, agent/model selection, returned results and follow-up messaging by session ID.

review.note: The only cited evidence (nov07-agents) shows delegation to subagents with their own permissions, but not that the coordinator can inspect or message them. That half is in gap-tools (results come back to the foreground; a background run returns a sessionID that can be prompted again), which COORD-03 cites and this mapping does not; add gap-tools and the value would stand.

review-ui.rationale: File diffs. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta.

license.rationale: MIT, subject to component notices. Scope: OpenCode desktop beta, OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

self-hosting.rationale: Shared or standalone local service. Scope: OpenCode terminal runtime, OpenCode shared server and HTTP API.

web-client.rationale: A released, password-protected web UI is served by the OpenCode runtime server and paired through one-use expiring links.

free-tier.rationale: The product FAQ says OpenCode is 100% free to use; it is a free download with included free models. Provider and Console model costs are separate.

starting-price.rationale: The OpenCode application is free; external providers and optional Console model plans are excluded as model costs.

roles.rationale: Console workspace roles Member/Admin/Owner have documented management and removal rules. This does not add roles to a local runtime.

sso.rationale: Console includes OIDC/SAML workspace SSO; local runtime auth remains separate.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Official V2 CLI example uses an external GitHub Actions pull_request event to start a standalone run. User configures CI; this is not a native scheduler.

no-paid-plan.rationale: Core OpenCode explicitly free; separate model plans excluded.

free-plan.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

subscription.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

usage-based.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

compute.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

one-time.rationale: The complete core OpenCode application is explicitly free. Optional Console/Go model plans and provider token/compute charges are separately sold model access, not paid ADE application plans.

issue-tracking.rationale: The bounded native core implements per-session todo tool state, without a separate cross-session issue/backlog work-item store.

pr-workflow.rationale: The available stable V1 GitHub App/Action implements a branch and submits a PR via the GitHub API. This receipt is explicitly V1 integration scope, not the V2 desktop command set.

laptop-independent.rationale: The same runtime can run on a user-operated always-on or remote host while clients connect over the network; that host, not the controlling laptop, executes work.

telemetry-default.rationale: Release builds inject a Sentry DSN and the desktop initializes Sentry unconditionally at startup.

telemetry-off-switch.rationale: Bounded source inspection shows collection gated only on the build-time DSN, with no user-facing or config control.
